name: Oodgeroo Noonuccal Undergraduate and Postgraduate Scholarship
summary: A scholarship for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students in QUT undergraduate or postgraduate courses.
key: $7,500 for undergraduate students and $10,000 for postgraduate students.
who: Undergraduates must be full time (36 credit points); postgraduates can be part time or full time.
Not in your final semester, and not a past recipient.
how: Apply with the application form, your transcript, two referee statements (one academic, one from an Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person) and a response to the selection criteria.
catches: Offered from Semester 1, 2027. The terms don't give the closing date.
Paid in two instalments a year, after each census date.

evidence.quote: valued at $7,500 for the undergraduate students, and $10,000 for the postgraduate students
Must be an Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander Person as defined
